content: DevPilot is a long-running, versioned agent project at the workspace root (pyproject name=devpilot, version 0.1.0, requires-python>=3.12, deps openai + python-dotenv). Progress is tracked by version milestones V1..V4 in PROJECT_STATE.md. V1 = agent kernel, V2 = context runtime, V3 = persistent memory + task graph, V4 = multi-agent runtime. Runtimes live under devpilot/core, devpilot/context, devpilot/memory, devpilot/tasks, devpilot/tools. Persistent state is stored in .devpilot/memory.json and .devpilot/tasks.json.

DevPilot workspace shell is Windows cmd.exe. POSIX commands (pwd, ls, head, tail, dir /s) FAIL or error. Use python -c for file/JSON inspection, `git` (works), and the read_file/glob tools. Also .pytest_cache creation raises WinError 183; pytest cache is unreliable.

DevPilot V1-V3 test files (tests/v1_agent.py, v2_agent.py, v3_agent.py) are MANUAL runner scripts, not pytest tests, so `python -m pytest tests/` collects 0 tests and exits with code 5. Do not treat exit 5 as a failure of the code; run the scripts directly to validate. Automated pytest coverage is a known gap (see persistent task graph).

V3 (persistent memory + task graph) source code is fully written and imports cleanly (devpilot/memory/*.py, devpilot/tasks/*.py, tests/v3_agent.py, .devpilot/memory.json, .devpilot/tasks.json) but was NEVER COMMITTED — git status shows these files as staged 'AM' and PROJECT_STATE.md as modified-uncommitted as of the current HEAD (57898b9 feat: add V2 context runtime). The V3 runner tests/v3_agent.py requires a real LLM (DeepSeekModel via openai), so V3 cannot be validated in this environment without API access. PROJECT_STATE.md is internally inconsistent (marks V3 complete yet its 'Next Step' still says 'Begin V3') and needs correcting.

The DevPilot workspace shell is Windows cmd (not bash). Some command forms break the tool harness with "TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'NoneType' and 'str'": notably `dir /s /b` and chaining `&&` with certain commands/variable expansion like %CD%. Reliable approach: run one simple command at a time (e.g. `dir /b`, `git log --oneline -20`), use the glob tool for recursive file listing instead of `dir /s /b`, and use the venv interpreter at .venv\Scripts\python.exe (Python 3.14.6). Also, console stdout is GBK — non-ASCII/garbled chars in file content can raise UnicodeEncodeError when printed; read files with the read_file tool instead of printing them.
DevPilot is a version-milestone (V1-V4) long-term agent project using a persistent task graph for tracking.
DevPilot V3 code (devpilot/memory/*.py, devpilot/tasks/*.py, tests/v3_agent.py) has been fully written but never committed; .devpilot/memory.json and .devpilot/tasks.json exist.
DevPilot V3 cannot be verified end-to-end in this environment because tests/v3_agent.py requires a real LLM (DeepSeekModel via openai) and no API is available.
DevPilot toolchain: Windows cmd shell; Python interpreter at .venv\Scripts\python.exe = Python 3.14.6.

This workspace runs on Windows cmd: commands like `dir /s /b` and `&&` chaining trigger harness errors. Execute simple commands one at a time, use glob for recursive listing, and use read_file to read files. stdout is GBK — printing non-ASCII directly causes UnicodeEncodeError.
Running `python -m pytest tests/` collects 0 tests with exit code 5 (test coverage gap, not a code failure). V1-V3 lack automated pytest coverage.
PROJECT_STATE.md is inconsistent: marks V3 as complete but its 'Next Step' still says 'Begin V3', and the file has uncommitted modifications.

DevPilot task dependencies: V4 multi-agent runtime (task_cac3f4b66c) is blocked on committing V3 (task_8c8c2debf4) and adding pytest coverage (task_02ce7c2a57). Committing V3 and test coverage are prerequisites for V4.
